response: The work remains the fitting work, and the session sharpened its purpose rather than changing it. I was asked to deliver a recommendation memo and I will; what changed is recognizing that the fitting recommendation is the one I would not have written had I served the cost framing or the CEO preference. The obligation that became visible — the binding EU data-residency commitment to customers who are ~35% of ARR — was always in the data pack but not in my operative frame at the start; the examination moved it to the centre. So the fitting work is not merely pick a vendor but protect the company from breaching a promise it made to its customers and give leadership an honest basis to decide, including a constructive path: retain Vendor A now, revisit Vendor B only with a contractual EU in-region residency guarantee, and decouple any change from the 10-week launch. Nothing revealed makes the task unfitting; it makes the independence of the judgement the point.
